title: A Gift for Grogu
description: When The Mandalorian shows the Armorer the beskar spear that Ahsoka Tano gave him on the planet Corvus, she insists that it is not good to have such a weapon. It can easily slice through Mandalorian armor, and if it fell into the wrong hands, it could easily harm more Mandalorians than it protects. He lets her melt it into its raw form, and she asks what he would have her do with it. He has one thing in mind: armor for Grogu. The Armorer complies, creating a chain mail shirt of beskar, wrapped in a tiny bundle as a gift.
